tasks.title: O1
tasks.statement: Figure 1 is a whole sky star chart of Yanqing, Beijing at 20:30 tonight (UTC+8) with the limit magnitude = 5m (m = magnitude). Four stars (about 1m - 3m) and one planet (brighter than 2m) are missing in this chart. In the chart, the distance from the centre is in proportion to zenith distance

parts.question: Draw a cross (X) on the location of each missing star and mark “T” on the chart, and draw a cross (X) on the location of the missing planet and mark “P” on the chart.
Please mark the orientation of the star chart with “N” “E” “S” “W” at the edge of the star chart.
On the chart, the celestial equator passes through many constellations. Please write down the name of any five of these constellations (IAU codes).
Using the star chart, estimate the altitude of Aldebaran (α Tau), to the nearest degree.

tasks.title: O2
tasks.statement: Figure 2 is a star chart of a recent opposition of Jupiter. The grid in the figure is the ecliptic coordinates. Please estimate the date of this opposition, to the nearest day.

tasks.title: O3
tasks.statement: Figure 3 is a star chart of a part of the sky on March 21, 2018. The longitude and latitude of the observation site is 120°E, 40°N (UTC+8). The grid in the figure is an equatorial grid. The thicker vertical line in the centre is the meridian. Estimate the mean solar time to an accuracy of better than 0.5h.
